paper.title: RNF168 binds and amplifies ubiquitin conjugates on damaged chromosomes to allow accumulation of repair proteins

control.source: IDR bulk annotation table for well 1034014 (https://idr.openmicroscopy.org/webgateway/table/Screen.plateLinks.child.wells/1034014/query/?query=Well-1034014), i.e. idr0010-screenA-annotation.csv

tiles.study_title: High content screen for genes whose downregulation by RNAi affects acccumulation of p53-binding protein 1 (53BP1) at sites of double strand breaks
tiles.chosen: The rule: the plate has 8 negative-control wells; 4 pass the study's quality control (Quality Control blank); 2 of those are outside the outer 2 rows and columns of the 12 x 32 layout. This is the sharpest of them, field 1, by the DNA-channel focus score.

ranking.score: focus: mean |Laplacian of Gaussian, sigma 1 px| over the brightest quarter of DNA-channel pixels / their mean, x100; higher is sharper

tiles.chosen: The paired control of the old tile (E1, siRNA s25059 against C20orf26): same plate, same antibody (HPA009079; IDR leaves the control well's antibody blank, but its Comments give the raw image directory "plate 1 E1F1 ab 13 c20orf26", the same as E1 and F1), same field; scrambled siRNA instead of the target siRNA. The study did not validate this antibody's localization (E1: "Validated localizations: none"), so the green channel is not a validated protein location.
